reason: The README describes a dsh plugin whose primary purpose is orchestrating LLM provider and model fallback chains for root agents and subagents, with role-based routing, time-slot selection, retries, cooldowns, and diagnostics.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh 智能体和子智能体提供基于角色的 LLM 提供商与模型备用链、重试切换、时段路由及诊断功能。
summaries.en: Provides dsh agents and subagents with role-based LLM provider and model fallback chains, retries, time-slot routing, and diagnostics.

capabilities: Routes failed LLM requests through configured provider and model fallback chains
Applies role-based routing for root agents and subagents
Retries failed requests and enforces cooldown and revert policies
Reads and updates fallback configuration through web, TUI, or YAML settings
Provides in-session fallback diagnostics and an optional script to repair legacy session logs
